title: DO NOT BUY THIS ITEM
text: DO NOT BUY THIS ITEM. DO NOT BUY! It became a mound of fuzz on first wash in cold water gentle hand wash setting.  I ruined two vaccuum filters sucking up short prickly hairs this "blanklet" is made of. IT IS NOT a three layer Vellux blanket!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!  No foam core!!!!!!!!!! Just a China made plastic sheet made of zazor like hairs poked through. They fall out and we breath this mess??????? It is still flying around laundry room.  Ruined my hepa filters on vac's.  Seller refunded fast - no return - I threw it in trash. Cant even donate such an unhealthy item. Is anythng made well in China? Anything?

features: This color Ivory appears closer to Eggshell

description: A truly remarkable blanket with a unique velvety texture, Vellux provides warm yet lightweight comfort, will not mat or pill and washed beautifully. In fact, the more you wash it, the softer it gets. No wonder it is featured in many of America's finest hotels. It's the durable blanket that lasts a lifetime. The Martex Velluxe is America's best selling blanket. It's the top choice for parents with children and the top choice for hotels nation-wide. Velvety and luxurious. Hypo-allergenic. Very durable, withstands frequent washings. Will not fade, pill, stretch, or matt. The perfect year-round blanket because it's lightweight but warm. Offered in a broad assortment of colors.

This dreamily soft blanket from Martex feels just like velvet, but is remarkably lightweight and easy to maintain. It is made with millions of nylon surface fibers and two layers of insulating polyurethane foam for maximum warmth and comfort. The plush surface wont mat or pill no matter how many times the blanket is washed. Plus, it wont fade or lose its velvety softness. This blanket is used in many hotels around the world because its hypoallergenic and withstands frequent washings. Because its breathable and lightweight, its perfect for use in all seasons. Since its available in a range of stylish colors, it will compliment any décor. This blanket would add a special touch of luxury to your guest bed, but once you experience its softness, youll probably want one for your own bed, as well.
